proposals.title: Write a hard photo-repeat floor into strategy §2's media ladder: no photograph twice inside 7 days, and X drops to text-only rather than repeat a tile
proposals.evidence: Your own rejection on 2026-09-21: "Not approved. we've used this image before" — the first ❌ in the ledger. It was unavoidable under the current rules: social/photo-library.json holds 10 photographs and the calendar consumes 14 photo slots a week, so every photo was shipping roughly every ten days and several shipped twice inside one week. Nine of the ten are from the same 2023 Inglewood Eras Tour night. Strategy §2 already permits text-only X posts (rung 3) and §3 already excludes them from the media-mix target, but nothing anywhere forbids a repeat, so nothing stopped it.
proposals.cost: X posts lose their images. Images do lift X engagement, and we have no reach data to measure how much we'd give up. Against that: 7 photo slots a week against 10 photographs is the only arrangement where nothing repeats inside a week, and the grid — the thing you judge this account by — is Instagram, which keeps every photo it has.
proposals.onApprove: Next Monday's run opens tree/strategy/2026-W39-1 as its own PR adding the repeat floor and the text-only fallback to §2, quoting this proposal and your ✅. A human merges it. I've already planned this fortnight that way, so approval just makes it permanent rather than a calendar note.
proposals.onReject: X keeps carrying photos, and I plan around repeats instead — which in practice means accepting a repeat roughly every ten days and telling you in the brief each time it happens, rather than you finding it in a draft.
